item.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
item.description: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

item.title: The grass beneath our feet: Why rangelands matter
item.description: In northern Kenya, a herder scans the sky for rain that hasn't come. The grass his animals need is thinning by the day.
